description: ROLE B surrogate-reviewer record over a frozen Agent Proposal with the same Evidence Pack. Reviewer must not modify the pack or fetch new evidence.

reviewer_context.description: E.g. fresh-session surrogate; records isolation measures taken.

review_class.description: NO_EDIT: semantic value unchanged. MINOR_EDIT: format/path/syntax/clarity only, remediation logic unchanged. MAJOR_EDIT: changes target version, strategy, dependencies, artifact identity, command behavior, or validation semantics. REJECT: unsafe/unsupported/unusable. ABSTENTION_ACCEPTED: agent correctly declined on insufficient evidence.
